title: Coordination Polymer & MOF Structure Lab
description: Browser-based batch analysis of CIF files of metal–organic complexes, coordination polymers and metal–organic frameworks: network dimensionality and interpenetration, secondary building units, metal coordination geometry and distortion (continuous shape measures, bond-valence sums), ligand binding modes, hydrogen bonds, π–π stacking and porosity, with tables, figures, a 3D viewer and a Word report. Single self-contained HTML file, no installation.
